headline: Colonials Regain Ground in Weathered Expanse as Toll Mounts
war_summary: Since our last edition the Weathered Expanse has tipped further toward the Colonials: their flags now fly over six posts against a single Warden holdout, with two grounds in ruin, and Wightwalk remains the busiest field with twenty actions logged in the day. Callahan's Passage keeps its grim place as the war's shambles yard — nine Warden strongholds to one Colonial, Crumbling Post worked over seventeen times, the hourly reckoning climbing past five hundred Colonial and three hundred seventy Warden fallen. The Nevish Line stands even at four posts apiece, Grief Mother the busiest ground, with fresh actions inside two hours and the hourly toll accelerating. Mooring County, ten Warden posts to two Colonial, saw movement within the half hour. Kuura Strand, ablaze at our last writing, has gone quiet these past two and a half hours with all six posts still Warden-held, and Stlican Shelf has been still since mid-afternoon. Palantine Berm's churn around The Droll — twenty-five actions in a day — likewise cooled toward evening. Marban Hollow logged no post actions yet bled heavily, near five thousand Warden and three thousand Colonial fallen in six hours. Day five hundred thirty-three closes with the thirty-four victory towns still unclaimed.
